title: ActRun Event
description: Version 1.0.0 event written to the ActRun append-only event log.

schema_version.description: Version of the serialized event contract.

timestamp.description: Event timestamp in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 format.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent that emitted the event.

action.description: Namespaced event action, for example workspace.branch, workspace.commit, coordination.conflict, lease.acquire or lease.release.
